title: MARLIN: Multiscale And Directional Sparse Representation Learning for Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.20065v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite recent progress in SAR maritime monitoring, ship classification remains challenging due to limited labeled data, class imbalance, large intra-class variability, fine-grained inter-class similarity, and variations in target scale, orientation, and backscattering structure. To address these challenges, this paper proposes MARLIN, a class-frequency-aware framework with directional sparse and hierarchical multi-scale feature extraction for ship type classification in SAR images. The proposed architecture first constructs two complementary representations of each input image, where each views are processed by parallel encoder branches. Each branch begins with a directional sparse convolutional stem designed to capture elongated and orientation-dependent ship scattering patterns, followed by customized hierarchical multiscale feature extraction blocks. translated_title: MARLIN：面向不平衡SAR船舶分类的多尺度与方向性稀疏表示学习
translated_abstract: 尽管近年来SAR海洋监测取得了进展，但受限于标注数据稀缺、类别不平衡、类内变化大、类间细粒度相似性高，以及目标尺度、方向和后向散射结构的差异，船舶分类仍然具有挑战性。为应对这些问题，本文提出了MARLIN，这是一个类别频率感知的框架，结合方向性稀疏与层次化多尺度特征提取，用于SAR图像中的船舶类型分类。该架构首先为每张输入图像构建两个互补的表示，每个视图由并行的编码器分支处理。每个分支以一个方向性稀疏卷积主干开始，用于捕捉细长且依赖方向的船舶散射模式，随后是定制化的层次化多尺度特征提取模块。为了在类别分布不平衡的情况下改进学习效果，我们引入了一种类别频率感知的……
tldr: 提出MARLIN框架，通过方向性稀疏卷积主干、层次化多尺度特征提取与类别频率感知机制，应对SAR船舶分类中标注数据稀缺、类别不平衡以及目标尺度与方向多变等挑战。
en_tdlr: MARLIN is a class-frequency-aware framework that combines directional sparse convolutional stems with hierarchical multi-scale feature extraction to address imbalanced SAR ship classification under limited labels and varying target scale and orientation.
